headline: The Buyback Machine Hiding Behind Cardinal Health's Thin Margins
summary: A steadily shrinking share count and a giant float owed to suppliers are handing owners a bigger slice of the drug distributor each year, even as drug-pricing worries hang over the stock.

headline: Is McKesson (MCK) a Buy as Wall Street Analysts Look Optimistic?
summary: According to the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), one should invest in McKesson (MCK). It is debatable whether this highly sought-after metric is effective because Wall Street analysts' recommendations tend to be overly optimistic. Would it be worth investing in the stock?
